entities.canonical_name: Kimi K3 availability in GitHub Copilot

sources.title: Kimi K3 in GitHub Copilot (bound Discovery source)
sources.role: Bound GitHub first-party availability/changelog source; claims are limited to Copilot distribution and governance.

claims.text: GitHub states that Kimi K3, described in the changelog as an open-weight model, is generally available in GitHub Copilot and hosted by GitHub on Fireworks AI.
GitHub records a temporary rollout pause while an incident with GitHub Actions was mitigated and says the rollout resumed on August 6, 2026; usage-based billing follows provider list pricing.

GitHub says rollout begins for Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise, with model-picker availability across Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, Copilot CLI, Copilot cloud agent, the Copilot app, github.com, GitHub Mobile, JetBrains, Xcode, and Eclipse.
GitHub says the rollout is gradual and Copilot Business and Enterprise keep Kimi K3 off by default until a plan administrator enables the Kimi K3 policy.

limitations.text: GitHub advises administrators to assess open-weight models against their own security, compliance, and data-governance requirements; those requirements are not independently evaluated here.
limitations.context: Governance limitation stated by the source.

limitations.text: This card does not import external Kimi benchmarks or Moonshot performance claims; it is limited to GitHub Copilot availability, hosting, rollout, billing, and policy context.
limitations.context: Source boundary retained for downstream use.
